title: Aktarma
canDo: Başkalarının söylediklerini dolaylı anlatımla aktarabilir, say ve tell'i doğru kullanabilir, zaman, zamir ve zaman ifadelerini değiştirebilir ve explain, promise, complain gibi fiillerle konuşmaları özetleyebilirim.
grammar: zaman kaydırma: perfect, past, will, can

liveClass.title: Kim ne dedi?
liveClass.goal: Öğrenciler "kulaktan kulağa" oyununun gelişmiş bir halini oynar: Her öğrenci kısa bir cümle duyar ve bir sonrakine He said that... / She told me that... ile aktarır. Sonra çiftler halinde birbirlerini hafta sonları hakkında röportaj yapar ve partnerlerinin söylediklerini aktarma fiilleriyle (explained, complained, admitted) sınıfa anlatır.

learn.explanation:
**Dolaylı anlatım (reported speech)**, birinin söylediğini **onun kelimeleriyle değil**, kendi cümlemizle aktarmaktır.

| Doğrudan | Dolaylı |
|---|---|
| Seda: "I **am** tired." | Seda said (that) she **was** tired. |
| Seda: "I **want** to go home." | She told me (that) she **wanted** to go home. |

Aktarma fiili geçmişte olduğu için (said, told) **zaman bir adım geriye** gider: present simple → **past simple**, present continuous → **past continuous**.

- "I'm working." → He said he **was working**.

**say mi tell mi?**

| say | tell |
|---|---|
| say (that) ... | tell **+ kişi** (that) ... |
| She **said** she was tired. | She **told me** she was tired. |
| She said **to me** ... (az kullanılır) | ~~She told that...~~ |

**that** günlük konuşmada genellikle atlanır.

examples.en: She told us she lived in Ankara.
They said they were waiting for a taxi.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçede "Yorgun olduğunu söyledi" derken zaman değişmez gibi görünür, ama İngilizcede said'den sonra zaman geriye kayar: "She said she is tired" yerine "She said she was tired". Ayrıca "söylemek" fiilinin iki karşılığı vardır: kişi varsa tell (told me), kişi yoksa say (said).

options: She told that she was tired.
She said that she was tired.
She told me that she was tired.

lessons.title: Zaman geri gider
lessons.goal: Present perfect, past simple, will ve can içeren cümleleri doğru zaman kaydırmasıyla aktarabilirim.

discover.title: Müşteri temsilcisinin notları
discover.body:
Call 1 – Mr Kaya
Mr Kaya said he had ordered a sofa three weeks ago, but it hadn't arrived. He told me he had called twice already. I explained that the delivery company would bring it on Friday.

Call 2 – Ms Er
Ms Er said she couldn't log in to her account. She said she had tried five times. I told her I would send her a new password by email.

Call 3 – Mr Tan
Mr Tan said he was very happy with his new washing machine. He said it was quieter than his old one and he would recommend us to his friends.

questions.explanation: "he had ordered a sofa three weeks ago, but it hadn't arrived"

questions.explanation: "I would send her a new password by email"

learn.explanation:
**Zaman kaydırma tablosu:**

| Doğrudan | Dolaylı |
|---|---|
| present simple: "I **work**." | past simple: he said he **worked** |
| present continuous: "I'**m working**." | past continuous: he said he **was working** |
| present perfect: "I'**ve ordered** it." | past perfect: he said he **had ordered** it |
| past simple: "I **ordered** it." | past perfect: he said he **had ordered** it |
| **will**: "I'**ll** call." | **would**: she said she **would** call |
| **can**: "I **can't** log in." | **could**: she said she **couldn't** log in |
| **am/is/are going to**: "I'm going to stay." | **was/were going to**: he said he **was going to** stay |

**Not:** Günlük konuşmada past simple bazen değişmeden kalabilir: He said he **ordered** it last week. ✓

**Hâlâ doğru olan bilgiler** değişmeyebilir: She said she **lives** in Bursa. (Hâlâ orada yaşıyor.)

examples.en: "I've lost my keys." → She said she had lost her keys.
"I'll help you." → He said he would help me.

learn.explanation:
Aktarırken **kişi, yer ve zaman** değişebilir, çünkü konuşan ve zaman farklıdır.

**Zamirler:**

- Asya: "**I** left **your** book." → She said **she** had left **my** book.

**Zaman ve yer ifadeleri** (farklı bir zamanda / yerde aktarıyorsak):

| Doğrudan | Dolaylı |
|---|---|
| today | **that day** |
| tonight | **that night** |
| tomorrow | **the next day** / the following day |
| yesterday | **the day before** / the previous day |
| next week | **the next week** / the following week |
| last week | **the week before** |
| now | **then** / at that time |
| here | **there** |
| this | **that** |
| ago | **before** |

**Aynı gün ve aynı yerde** aktarıyorsak değişmeyebilir:

- (Bugün) Ali said he would come **tomorrow**. ✓

lessons.title: Söz verdi, şikâyet etti
lessons.goal: explain, promise, complain, admit gibi aktarma fiilleriyle söylenenleri daha net aktarabilirim.

discover.title: Apartman toplantısından notlar
discover.body:
Last night's building meeting was a long one.

Mrs Avcı complained that the lift had been out of order for two weeks. The building manager apologised and explained that the repair company was very busy. He promised that the lift would work again by Monday.

Mr Öz mentioned that some people were leaving rubbish bags in the corridor. Nobody admitted that they had done it, but everyone agreed that it was a problem.

Finally, the manager announced that the building would get a new security camera next month. Everyone replied that it was a great idea.

questions.prompt: What did Mrs Avcı complain about?
questions.explanation: "the lift had been out of order"

questions.prompt: What did the manager promise?
options: The lift would work again by Monday
questions.explanation: "He promised that the lift would work again by Monday."

learn.explanation:
**said** yerine daha **anlamlı aktarma fiilleri** kullanmak anlatımı zenginleştirir. Hepsi **(that) + cümle** ile kullanılabilir.

| Fiil | Anlam | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| **explain** | açıklamak | He **explained that** the company was busy. |
| **promise** | söz vermek | He **promised that** it would work by Monday. |
| **complain** | şikâyet etmek | She **complained that** the lift was broken. |
| **admit** | kabul / itiraf etmek | He **admitted that** he had forgotten. |
| **agree** | katılmak | Everyone **agreed that** it was a problem. |
| **mention** | bahsetmek | She **mentioned that** she was moving. |
| **announce** | duyurmak | The manager **announced that** ... |
| **reply** | cevap vermek | He **replied that** he didn't know. |

**Dikkat:** explain **+ kişi** olmaz, **to + kişi** gerekir:

- He explained **to me** that ... (~~He explained me~~)

My son promised that he would tidy his room.
The teacher explained to us that the exam was easy.

learn.explanation:
**Mesaj almak:**

- **Can I take a message?** (Mesaj bırakmak ister misiniz?)
- **I'll pass on the message.** / I'll tell her you called.
- **Could you tell him (that)** I called?

**Mesajı aktarmak:**

| Kalıp | Örnek |
|---|---|
| X called. **He said (that)** ... | Mr Polat called. He said he was going to be late. |
| **She asked me to tell you (that)** ... | She asked me to tell you that she'd be here at four. |
| **According to** X, ... | According to Ali, the meeting is cancelled. |
| **Apparently**, ... | Apparently, the flight was delayed. |

**Özetlemek:** Her kelimeyi aktarmak gerekmez. **Önemli bilgiyi** seçin:

- "Hi, it's Polat. Look, I'm really sorry, but my flight's late, and, you know, I won't be there until four."
- → **He said** his flight was late **and** he **wouldn't** be there until four.

examples.en: Your mum called. She said she would call back later.
examples.tr: Annen aradı. Sonra tekrar arayacağını söyledi.

examples.en: According to the weather forecast, it's going to snow.

learn.turkishNote: "... söylememi istedi" yapısı İngilizcede "asked me to tell you" ile kurulur. "According to" kalıbından sonra kişinin ya da kaynağın adı gelir; "according to me" denmez, kendi fikriniz için "in my opinion" kullanılır.

options: Do you want to say me?

In the meeting, the manager explained that the office would close early on Friday. She also announced that there would be a team lunch next week. Everyone agreed that it was a great idea!

Kaan

questions.modelAnswer: You won't believe my conversation with Burcu yesterday! She told me she had quit her job. She explained that she had been unhappy there for a long time and she wanted to start her own business. She said she was going to open a small bakery near the university. She admitted that she was a bit scared, but she said she had saved enough money for a year. She mentioned that her brother would help her with the shop. I told her it was a brave decision.
